verdicts.level_absolute: REAL miss of the transferred level; 99.7% of the mean square is one corpus-wide offset, -0.39 of the -0.49 b/B is the bytes curve (TinyStories n0, nu on a FineWeb learner); the SmolLM2 reference tops out at 2.00 b/B, below every 2^21 cell, so the 2^21 cells were out of the forecaster's reach (a design flaw that does not change the verdict)
verdicts.level_tokenizer_shift: REAL: predicted token advantage -0.108 b/B against measured -0.016; with one bytes anchor ours 0.120 vs c0 0.024
verdicts.ordering: REAL negative for b (S1 rho 0.15, p 0.33); positive object: count statistics order tokenizers (type event count rho 0.60-0.65 over 16, p <= 0.01, on budgets unseen when written)
verdicts.rate: Good: token data-scaling slopes predicted to 0.006 b/B per doubling rms (bytes slope too steep by 0.030); exponent ratio tokens/bytes 0.92-1.07 with bytes to 2^25 under any floor, 1.08 shift-invariant; between-tokenizer rate differences not predicted
verdicts.drift: REAL miss of the zero-drift point (+0.02 to +0.29 over two doublings, 10/10 S1 positive); MISREAD as a loss to Cagnetta (1.9-2.8 predicted for S1; all 10 measured drifts are nearer 0 once the four censored 2^21 ends are read off the extended ladder); the rise is the positive object, too slow to reach b^c in this learner's range
